rows.en: I'll smash every last one of you!!

rows.notes: Konno! as a strike shout; rendered 'Take this!!'.

rows.en: I've got no time to play around with you!!
I'm Domon Kasshu, King of Hearts of the Shuffle Alliance!
Don't take this God Gundam for just any Gundam!
Gwah! B-beaten by someone like this...
D-damn it!! I can't go down to something like this!!
Uoooh!! Wh-what?! I'm being pushed back?!
Nuooooh!! Th-this guy... has this much power...
Gaaah!! Y-you're good! But I can't afford to lose!!

uncertain: Shared with Ryoma, Ko, Hokuto: generic scream, works for all.

rows.en: N-not yet!! I'm not done yet!!
I-I'm not going down yet!! I swear it on the name of King of Hearts!!
Waaah!! D-damn it! I won't lose!!
Not bad! But this fight isn't settled yet!!
Is that all your skill amounts to?!
Tch! Get out of my way!
Ngh! Don't think something like this can beat me!
What's wrong! Is that the best you can do!
An attack like that won't work on me!!
I've already seen through your attacks!!
As if missiles like that could...!
It's useless! Missiles won't work on me!
What?! Damn it, I'm out of ammo?!
Attacking from out of range? What a dirty trick!!
I'll be the one to send you to your grave!
An opening! I'll finish you off!
I won't let you do that while I'm here!
rows.notes: Read as protecting an ally: he won't let the enemy strike while he is present.

rows.en: I will win this battle, no matter what!

rows.notes: Hissatsu (certain-kill) shout before a special move.
uncertain: Rendered hissatsu as 'Fiiinishing move!'; could also be left as 'Hissatsu!'.

rows.en: Get kicked by a horse and fall to Hell!!
rows.notes: Japanese idiom: whoever gets in the way of lovers gets kicked by a horse. Kept literal; it is the Love Love attack context.
uncertain: Horse idiom kept literal; English players may not get the reference ('anyone who gets between lovers gets kicked by a horse').

rows.en: It roars and cries out to me to grasp victory!!
rows.notes: Second half of the famous God Finger chant (My hand burns red...). Subject restored as 'it' = the hand.

uncertain: Heat End not in glossary; used the standard G Gundam form 'Heat End'.

rows.en: Here I go!! In the name of the School of the Undefeated of the East!!

rows.notes: Erupting = glossary for Bakunetsu.
Shared Domon/Rain combo set; Domon's line.
Rain's reply.

rows.en: These hands of ours are burning red!
rows.notes: Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken chant, said together.

uncertain: Pronoun 'They' = the two hands from q06631; chant is split across three rows.

rows.notes: First syllable of Sekiha, split between the two speakers with the next row.
uncertain: Seki / Ha split of Sekiha across two rows, each likely said by a different speaker; kept as syllables.

rows.notes: Second syllable of Sekiha.
Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken (glossary), stretched.

rows.en: What the hell d'you think you're doin', huh?!
You're a real pain, y'know that?!
A slow turtle's attack could never hit the great me!
rows.notes: Identical to q06660 except punctuation; same English.

rows.en: Yeeeehahaha, that won't work on me!
A slow turtle's attack could never hit the great me!
rows.notes: Identical to q06658 except punctuation; same English.
Todome (finishing blow) shout.

uncertain: Wind Fire (Michelo) is not in the glossary; romanized from the katakana. Needs akurasu/wiki check.

rows.notes: Silver Legs from glossary (terms, technique).
uncertain: Glossary has 'Silver Legs' for Michelo's technique; extended as 'Hyper Silver Legs Special'.
Shared with Sayaka Yumi; neutral attack shout works for both.
q06667 and q06669 both mean 'fall/go down'; given different wording to keep them distinct.

rows.en: Just because I'm a woman... doesn't mean I'll lose!
Aaah!! I-I'm going to be taken down!?
N-no! Hold out a little longer!!
rows.notes: Addressed to her own machine, asking it to hold out.

rows.en: Ah! Ah! ...Ngh, I-I have to pull myself together!
N-not yet! I'm just getting started!
Kyaa! I-it'll take more than this!
It hit me?! But this much I can handle!
Aah! So what, it's only this much!!
Like that's going to hit me!!
Ph-phew, looks like it didn't hit me
Not yet!! This is nothing at all!
Something like this won't work on me!
A beam like this, I can take!!
rows.notes: Ends on 'nara' with the rest implied; completed as 'I can take'.
uncertain: Source trails off after 'if it's a beam like this'; completed as 'I can take' to keep a verb. Could stay as a fragment.

rows.en: It's no good! It's too far from here!
rows.notes: Out-of-range line.

uncertain: Shared with Aqua Centrum; works for both.

rows.notes: Hissatsu hicchuu; 'Sure Hit' follows glossary 必中.

rows.en: Crush... everything... I'll crush anything and everything!
rows.notes: Argo under DG Cell control: broken, menacing delivery.

rows.en: Heheheh... I can feel it... the power welling up...!
I'll grind you to mincemeat... I swear it...!
Don't think you'll always win...! Domon Kasshu!
rows.notes: Addressed to Domon.

rows.en: Heheheh... so you're coming at me...
Impossible! Me! The way I am now... losing?!
I'll kill you... you insolent bastard... I'll kill you for sure!
That's enough to make me angry... next time, you die...!
How boring... You think you can beat me with this?!
Pathetic... You're far too pathetic, you bastard...!
Boring... Quit the boring tricks and come at me head-on!
Come closer! Closer! Come closer to me!
Move...! Or do you want to be crushed along with the rest?!

uncertain: Shared with George and Chibodee; wordless, works for all.

rows.en: Everything! I'll smash everything to pieces! Nuoooooh!!
The power's overflowing...! With this... I won't lose to anyone!
I'm not the same me as before... not anymore!
I can win... I can beat anybody!
Bro... this time I'm gonna win... I won't lose!
rows.notes: Aniki = Domon; 'Bro' as Sai's usual address.

rows.en: Now... it's your turn to die. Your turn to die, pal!
Hehehe... I'll pay you back... with plenty of interest!
uncertain: 'Payback with plenty of interest' adds the idiom 'interest' for 'generously'.

rows.en: I won't accept it! My power's way more than this!
Now you've made me mad... for real this time!
No way... I was supposed to have invincible power!
That's a fun trick... Guess you've just gotta die, pal!
I'll kill you, okay? ...I'll kill you for sure!
That doesn't even count as a hit. You're weak, pal!
Useless! It's way too useless! Hahahahahaha!
Moron! Missiles don't work on me!
Heheheh... you're not too bright, huh?
Not bad... that pisses me off... It really pisses me off!
Move! I said get outta my way!
Get smashed to bits by my Feilong Flag!
Like you could ever see through my Bueikyaku!
rows.notes: Bueikyaku from glossary (No-Shadow Kick).
uncertain: Used 'Bueikyaku' short form of the glossary entry 'Bueikyaku (No-Shadow Kick)'; brackets omitted.

rows.en: I'm gonna turn you into charcoal!
I'll have you die... and make very sure of it
uncertain: George's polite-menacing tone; 'I'll have you die' keeps the polite causative feel. Could be 'You will die... I'll make sure of it'.

rows.en: With this power... I won't lose... I am the victor!
I won't lose to you anymore! I said I won't lose!
You dare defy me? ...Then you have no choice but to die!
I, who gained this power... losing?! That can't be!
I won't forgive this, from the likes of you!
rows.notes: Damage reaction: outrage that someone like the enemy hurt him.
uncertain: Literal object of 'won't forgive' is implied (the enemy hurting him); rendered as 'this'.

rows.en: Weak... You're not even worth talking about
You think you can hit me? Don't mock me, you fool!
You... You intend to make a fool of me?!
Move, move! Get out of my way!!
I'll cut you to ribbons... Kukukukuku

rows.notes: Rose Bit from glossary, stretched.

rows.en: This power... a splendid power of destruction! Roooose! Screamer!
rows.notes: Rose Screamer from glossary, stretched.

rows.en: I won't lose to anybody... I'm the champion!!
This power... yeah, this is the power I wanted!
Domon... with this power... I won't lose to you again...!
rows.notes: Addressed to Domon.

rows.en: Gaaah! No way! Me! Me, of all people!
I'll never forgive you... doing that to me, the Champ...!
rows.notes: Outrage at what the enemy did to him; 'the Champ' = Chibodee's self-image.

rows.en: I'm still goin' strong, I can take it with no guard!
uncertain: Unclear nuance of the trailing hearsay particle; read as boasting he can still fight with no guard.

rows.en: You think that'll KO me?! Ha!
You call that aiming? What a joke, hyahahaha!
You think that kinda thing works on me? Naive, way too naive
Pulling a stunt like that... I'll kill you for sure...!
I'll grind you into mincemeat... with my punches! Hahaa!
Burn to a crisp with this, damn it!
uncertain: Original says become burnt charcoal; rendered 'burn to a crisp'.
